study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting task-based fMRI activity using normative modelling: an application to the Emotional Face Matching Task

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study uses six datasets. HCP-YA, HCP-D, UK Biobank, and MIND-Set are mapped to the provided list. AOMIC PIOP2 and Duke Neurogenetics Study are also used but not in the standard list.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We collated a large reference sample from 6 independent sites for whom high quality fMRI data for the EFMT are available: AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult (1200 release), UK Biobank, and the MIND-Set cohort

answer.UK Biobank: reference normative model training/testing; out-of-sample validation

answer.MIND-Set: reference normative model training/testing (unaffected controls); clinical test (patients)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Data from 6 sites were used to build the reference normative models (split into train/test). An additional 5000 participants from UK Biobank were used for out-of-sample validation. The MIND-Set cohort included a patient group used for clinical testing of the models.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: We collated a large reference sample from 6 independent sites... to first (i) build reference normative models... We then apply these models to over 200 participants... from the MIND-Set cohort... to (iii) map deviations in patients... We further validated our reference model with an additional out-of-sample/unseen 5000 participants from UK Biobank.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Savage2024.pdf.md: Introduction, Paragraph 5; Methods / Normative models; Supplementary Materials: Supplementary Results / Additional out of sample test...

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative models were estimated for faces>shapes and faces>baseline contrasts using 7728 individuals from the reference datasets. The data was split into training and test sets stratified by site.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: We estimate large-scale (N = 7728) normative models... we split the data into training and test splits, stratified by site (face>shapes -train: 3885, test: 3843; faces>baseline -train: 3778, test: 3950...).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Savage2024.pdf.md: Results / Fitting reference normative models..., Paragraph 1

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD were calculated for the overall reference sample (N=7728) based on site-specific summary statistics provided in Table 1.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Female counts were summed from Table 1 for the reference datasets (Total N=7728).
